title: Can the stockmarket swallow Anthropic, SpaceX and OpenAI?
summary: This Economist article examines whether public stock markets can accommodate three private AI giants—Anthropic, SpaceX, and OpenAI—whose valuations have reached extraordinary levels, raising questions about market capacity, investor appetite, and the structural challenges of bringing these companies public.
problem_solved: Explores the structural mismatch between extremely valuable private AI companies and the public markets that would need to absorb them.
why_valuable: Provides critical analysis of how unprecedented private AI valuations might impact or be absorbed by public markets, relevant for investors and policymakers.
